name: Reflecting pool
description: Follow Reflecting pool, a tracked object, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: White House asked DOJ about new Reflecting Pool case against David Hearn
changes.summary: Earlier this month, however, federal prosecutors moved to dismiss the case, citing new information that the damage was caused by a "botched installation" by a contractor, not vandalism.

changes.title: Trump talks about the Reflecting Pool and White House ballroom a lot. Here's exactly how much
changes.summary: PolitiFact analyzed all of Trump's public events and speeches over the first seven months of 2026 in which he mentioned his construction projects — including the White House ballroom and Reflecting Pool — and beautifying the nation's capital.

changes.title: Olympic canoeist charged by Jeanine Pirro seeks to permanently sink Reflecting Pool case
changes.summary: Attorneys for the former Olympic canoeist the Trump administration had charged in a felony Reflecting Pool case are seeking to permanently bar any effort to resurface what they called a “politically motivated prosecution” of their client.

changes.title: More Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool charges dropped by Pirro's office
changes.summary: Since Friday, D.C. U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro's office has dropped charges against three more people accused of vandalism.

changes.title: Trump says Jeanine Pirro "choked" in dropping Reflecting Pool cases
changes.summary: "She folded like an umbrella," President Trump said of Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia.

changes.title: Trump slams Jeanine Pirro for dropping Reflecting Pool vandalism cases, says she "choked"
changes.summary: "She folded like an umbrella," President Trump said of Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia.

changes.title: Ripple effects: Three people have Reflecting Pool charges dropped after Hearn request
changes.summary: Federal prosecutors moved to drop their case against David Hearn, blaming Reflecting Pool damage on a "botched installation" rather than vandalism. That has implications for others who were charged. (Image credit: Finn Gomez).

changes.title: Tamara Keith and Amy Walter on Democratic primary voters not playing it safe
changes.summary: NPR's Tamara Keith and Amy Walter of the Cook Political Report with Amy Walter join Amna Nawaz to discuss the latest political news, including the Michigan Senate primary and the message Democrats are taking into the midterms, prosecutors dropping Reflecting Pool vandalism charges and President Trump's response.

changes.title: Takeaways after Trump takes questions on Iran, Reflecting Pool in Oval Office
changes.summary: President Trump took reporter questions on the Iran war, the renovation of the reflecting pool in Washington, D.C., and more on Monday. CBS News' Lindsey Reiser and Natalie Brand share their biggest takeaways.
